description: Bundled norminette diagnostics, formatting, and status bar controls for 42 C projects.
command.showMenu.title: 42 Norm Formatter: Open Menu
command.runCurrentFile.title: 42 Norm Formatter: Run Current File
command.runWorkspace.title: 42 Norm Formatter: Run Workspace
command.formatDocument.title: 42 Norm Formatter: Format Current Document
command.configure.title: 42 Norm Formatter: Configure
configuration.title: 42 Norm Formatter
config.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run the bundled norminette runner.
config.useGitignore.description: Skip files ignored by Git when running norminette.
config.compatibilityRules.description: Optional compatibility rule names passed as -R values to norminette.
config.formatOnSave.description: Apply the built-in formatter before saving C and header files.
config.lintOnOpen.description: Run norminette when a supported file is opened.
config.lintOnChange.description: Run norminette while editing with a short debounce.
config.showStatusBar.description: Show the status bar entry used to open the extension menu.
config.traceRunner.description: Write runner stdout and stderr to the output channel for debugging.
config.headerEnabled.description: Insert or refresh the 42 header during formatting.
config.headerUsername.description: Username used in the generated 42 header.
config.headerEmail.description: Email address used in the generated 42 header.
config.removeFunctionScopeComments.descr: Dangerous rewrite: remove comments inside function bodies before formatting.
config.wrapSingleStatementBodies.descrip: Dangerous rewrite: wrap single-statement if/while/for/else bodies in braces before formatting. Opt-in only because it increases line count.
config.splitMultiInstructions.descriptio: Dangerous rewrite: split multiple instructions on one line into separate statements before formatting.
config.splitDeclarationAssignment.descri: Dangerous rewrite: split local variable declarations with initializers into separate declaration and assignment statements when possible.
config.hoistDeclarationsToFunctionTop.de: Dangerous rewrite: move local variable declarations from nested scopes or late positions to the top of the function body.
config.rewriteForToWhile.description: Dangerous rewrite: convert for-loops into while-loops before formatting.
config.allowUnsafeTransforms.description: Legacy bundle switch for most dangerous rewrites. Single-statement body wrapping stays opt-in; prefer the granular transform settings instead.
config.allowUnsafeTransforms.deprecation: Use the granular dangerous transform settings such as `normFormatter.wrapSingleStatementBodies`, `normFormatter.splitDeclarationAssignment`, and `normFormatter.rewriteForToWhile` instead.
